claims.statement: The official programme page updated in July 2026 provides multiple current documents, including funding and payment instructions, an energy-audit summary, a contractor agreement and a contractor acceptance protocol.
The programme states that an energy audit and audit-summary document are required before the funding application for relevant thermal-modernisation work.

Official contractor guidance updated in April 2026 says a contractor must meet an experience condition and that a non-standard contractor agreement must still contain mandatory terms from the official template.

contrary_evidence: The programme funds municipal consultation points that provide beneficiaries free support with applications and documents.
Official templates and instructions reduce the value of a tool for contractors with disciplined administration.
The beneficiary, not the contractor, holds ultimate responsibility for grant spending, which may limit contractor willingness to pay.

economics.acquisition_route: Use 20-30 historical jobs from the family firm to measure catches, recruit two neighbouring contractors via suppliers, then offer wholesalers a portfolio dashboard and recurring referral share.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Six hundred installer accounts averaging 700 PLN monthly plus 30000 dossiers per year at 70 PLN would yield about 7.14m PLN annual revenue. At a mature 40% owner-cash margin, roughly 2.86m PLN per year could compound to more than 10m PLN of distributions over five mature years without exit value.
economics.founder_time: Limit the first release to checklist selection and cross-document consistency at roughly 2.5-4 hours/day; keep employment until channel-led repeat purchases and contribution economics are demonstrated.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Once templates and extraction are stable, project checks are low-cost compute; target 75-88% gross margin excluding separately billed human audit support.
economics.payback: Target payback from one avoided correction cycle or a few saved administrator hours, but actual delay and correction costs need to be observed rather than assumed.
economics.pricing: Assumption to test: 299-999 PLN per installer branch per month plus 40-120 PLN per completed dossier, with a 1000-3000 PLN assisted setup tier.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every eligible project creates a repeated dossier, and programme revisions increase the value of maintained rules; retention falls if contractors leave subsidised retrofit work.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A versioned rule graph linking programme clauses, device eligibility, document fields and anonymised correction patterns improves detection of project-specific dossier gaps.
fingerprint.customer: Three-to-thirty-person Polish retrofit contractors and energy auditors completing repeat projects under the Czyste Powietrze programme.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Dogfood with the founder's parents' seven-person renewable-installation company, then sell through regional wholesalers, auditors and installer associations using short recorded demos and self-serve trials.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: White-label web workspace that selects the applicable programme version, builds an evidence checklist, extracts values from audit/contract/invoice/protocol files, flags contradictions and emits a signed preflight report; subscription plus project usage.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The contractor pays per active project or per branch when a dossier is preflighted; current spend is administrator time, correction work and cash tied up between installation and a clean payment submission.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A contractor is about to sign a project, order equipment or submit an acceptance/payment packet under a specific programme version and cannot quickly verify that all required facts and attachments agree.

founder_fit: The family installation company supplies an unusually low-cost, trusted pilot environment and domain feedback loop.
Document extraction, cross-field validation and rule versioning fit AI and data-science strengths.
Regional wholesalers and auditors can distribute the product without the founder becoming a public sales personality.
The initial workflow can be validated on past, redacted projects within a modest capital envelope while employment continues.
risks: A false green check could cause equipment commitment on an ineligible project.
Programme revisions can make cached rules obsolete quickly.
Files include personal, property and financial data requiring GDPR-compliant handling.
Free public operators or incumbent grant-service firms could bundle the same check.

structure.commercial_archetype: Per-project document-quality SaaS for a regulated installation workflow
structure.control_point: The go/no-go dossier check before equipment commitment and payment submission
structure.critical_dependency: Accurate machine-readable maintenance of each current programme version and access to real installer files with known correction outcomes

thesis: Sell small Polish insulation, window and heating installers a version-aware dossier preflight that catches missing or inconsistent grant, audit, contract, invoice and acceptance documents before work starts and before payment is requested. Installers already fund back-office labour and working capital while customer subsidy files are assembled; the product is a quality gate for paid projects, not consumer grant brokering.
title: Clean-Air Retrofit Dossier Preflight for Installers
uncertainties: The frequency, causes and cash cost of installer-side dossier corrections are not publicly quantified.
It is unknown whether contractors control enough of the beneficiary paperwork to use a unified workspace.
The family company may not represent installers with different project mixes or administrative maturity.
All price, margin, volume and wealth-path values are hypotheses requiring paid pilots.
